name: Magpie Subscription Usage
description: Shows the subscription allowance windows of Magpie's Claude and Codex accounts in Persona.

local_address.title: Local Magpie address
local_address.description: On the Persona manager's machine. The default needs no setup.

remote_address.title: Remote Magpie HTTPS address (optional)
remote_address.description: Leave empty to read local Magpie. Save this address before setting a dedicated read-only Magpie quota key.

secrets.name: magpie_quota_key
secrets.title: Remote Magpie quota key
secrets.description: A dedicated Magpie read-only key with quota access. Never sent to the local endpoint.
